alternatives.reason_rejected: changes node resolution priority in setups that worked under 1.24.0 — a behavior change with no field driver

alternatives.option: Keep replace, only add the well-known-dir append
alternatives.reason_rejected: a profile assigning PATH without $PATH passthrough still clobbers a workable inherited PATH

assumptions: Claude Code substitutes bare ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} directly in plugin .mcp.json across versions (doc-confirmed at code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp.md; field-confirmed on the 1.24.0 install)
The field machine's node shims in ~/.local/bin are representative of the interactive-rc-only PATH class the well-known-dir list must cover
context: Fixed both 1.24.0 field bugs test-first: .mcp.json guard now uses bare ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (the :- form expanded to empty via documented default-value expansion, exit 78 every session); launcher login-PATH recovery merges instead of replacing and probes well-known install dirs. 8 new tests. Adversarial review workflow still running; version bump + commit pending its result.
rationale: Login-first is strictly additive versus shipped 1.24.0 replace semantics: whenever replace resolved a runner the merged PATH resolves identically, so recovery only adds outcomes and never changes which node a working setup picks. The append covers dirs only interactive rcs add (~/.local/bin from .zshrc — the field failure) plus /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, volta/asdf/mise shims; nvm/fnm excluded (per-version dirs, no stable bin path). TWINING_LAUNCH_RECOVERY_DIRS is the test seam; TWINING_LAUNCH_NO_LOGIN_PATH now skips ALL recovery so test sandboxes hold.
summary: Login PATH merges login-first ahead of the inherited PATH (never replaces), with a well-known-dir append gated on node being unresolvable
